boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Named campus destinations with documented spaces for studying, making, performing, recreation and student connection.

cards.title: Blough-Weis Library
cards.subtitle: Study and collaboration spaces
cards.notes: Bring a project partner to one of the library’s study or collaboration spaces, then use its journals and media collections for focused work.
cards.short_summary: A library with seating and resources designed for individual and collaborative academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: Blough-Weis Library has study and collaboration spaces for more than 500 students, alongside journal, book and media collections.
cards.source_title: Buildings & Spaces on Campus | Susquehanna University
cards.access_notes: Use campus library access practices; the university identifies dedicated study and collaboration spaces.

cards.title: CEER Field Station
cards.subtitle: Research plots and walking/biking trails
cards.notes: Plan a daylight walk or bike ride on the field station trails, and pause to notice the research plots, greenhouse and solar array nearby.
cards.short_summary: An 87-acre campus-adjacent field station combining environmental research infrastructure and trails.
cards.evidence_claim: The 87-acre CEER Field Station includes research facilities, a greenhouse, solar array, beehives, research plots and walking/biking trails.
cards.source_title: Buildings & Spaces on Campus | Susquehanna University
cards.access_notes: Use marked trails and follow posted field-station guidance.

cards.title: Art Studio
cards.subtitle: Northern campus collaborative studios
cards.notes: If you are taking studio art, use the shared work areas to develop class projects and coordinate with peers between critiques or work sessions.
cards.short_summary: A northern-campus art facility with collaborative studio space and senior workspaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Art Studio supports painting, drawing, printmaking and sculpture classes and includes collaborative studio spaces.
cards.source_title: Buildings & Spaces on Campus | Susquehanna University
cards.access_notes: Studio use is connected to art classes; confirm access with the department.

cards.title: Cunningham Center for Music & Art
cards.subtitle: Practice rooms, rehearsal areas and concert hall
cards.notes: Schedule a music practice or group rehearsal when eligible, or attend a program in Stretansky Concert Hall and explore the arts classrooms nearby.
cards.short_summary: A combined music and art building with practice rooms, rehearsal areas, labs and a performance venue.
cards.evidence_claim: Cunningham Center contains Stretansky Concert Hall, 32 music practice rooms, group rehearsal areas, a computer music lab and art/design classrooms.
cards.source_title: Buildings & Spaces on Campus | Susquehanna University
cards.access_notes: Practice rooms and instructional spaces may require department affiliation or reservation.

cards.title: The Letterbox
cards.subtitle: Publishing and editing suite in Fisher Hall
cards.notes: Use this named Fisher Hall suite through relevant coursework or programming to edit, publish and workshop written material with classmates.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated publishing and editing suite within Fisher Hall’s learning spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Fisher Hall includes The Letterbox publishing and editing suite among its state-of-the-art learning spaces.
cards.source_title: Buildings & Spaces on Campus | Susquehanna University
cards.access_notes: Access is tied to the building’s academic spaces; check with the relevant program.

cards.title: Charles B. Degenstein Campus Center
cards.subtitle: Student organizations, services and gathering space
cards.notes: Start at the Burke Hawk Hub for campus resources, then look for organization offices or campus programming housed in the same center.
cards.short_summary: The central campus center known as “Deg,” combining student services, organizations, food and arts spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Degenstein Campus Center houses the Burke Hawk Hub, student organizations, Student Life, WQSU, The Quill, dining options and arts spaces.
cards.source_title: Buildings & Spaces on Campus | Susquehanna University
cards.access_notes: Campus services and organization spaces may have their own operating hours or access expectations.

cards.title: Charlie’s Lounge
cards.subtitle: Programming and informal work space in Deg
cards.notes: Check the campus calendar for a free program, or use the lounge as a place to do homework and talk with friends between commitments.
cards.short_summary: A Degenstein Campus Center lounge used for recurring student programming, relaxation and homework.
cards.evidence_claim: Charlie’s Lounge hosts free programming including movie, open-mic, karaoke, concert, craft, poetry and comedy events, and is used for homework and conversation.
cards.source_title: Buildings & Spaces on Campus | Susquehanna University
cards.access_notes: Programming is scheduled throughout the week; confirm the current event schedule before going.

cards.title: Lore Degenstein Gallery
cards.subtitle: Charles B. Degenstein Campus Center
cards.notes: Drop in during gallery hours to view the current exhibition, or return for the annual student exhibition highlighting graduating art and design majors.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus gallery presenting professional exhibitions and a yearly student capstone exhibition.
cards.evidence_claim: Lore Degenstein Gallery presents four exhibitions each academic year, including an annual exhibition for graduating graphic design and studio art majors; events are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Gallery hours are Monday–Sunday, 11 a.m.–5 p.m.; it is closed during university breaks.

cards.title: James W. Garrett Sports Complex
cards.subtitle: Recreation, intramurals and student lounge
cards.notes: Use the complex for an eligible recreational or intramural activity, and meet teammates in the student lounge before or after your session.
cards.short_summary: A campus sports complex bringing together aquatic, fitness, court, indoor-track and student-lounge spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Garrett Sports Complex supports varsity, intramural and recreational sports and includes an aquatic center, gym, fitness center, courts, indoor track and student lounge.
cards.source_title: Buildings & Spaces on Campus | Susquehanna University
cards.access_notes: Recreation facilities may require student eligibility, check-in or scheduled use.

cards.title: Writers Institute
cards.subtitle: Writing workshops, library and conference spaces
cards.notes: Use a writing workshop, conference space or the building library through a relevant class or program, then take a break in its student connection space.
cards.short_summary: A creative-writing building with workshops, a library, conference spaces and room to connect or unwind.
cards.evidence_claim: The Writers Institute contains creative-writing workshops, conference spaces and a library, and the university describes it as a space for students to connect and unwind.
cards.source_title: Buildings & Spaces on Campus | Susquehanna University
cards.access_notes: Workshop and conference-space use may be associated with creative-writing courses or programs.
